name: EPIC 220224455
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 6.6 solar radii and 1.51 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220224455 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.641916 (16th-84th percentiles 6.438847-6.843425), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220224455 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2014.921875 (16th-84th percentiles 1966.191406-2064.179688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,015 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.51 solar masses and 6.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,034 K at its surface.
